lines.speaker: night_clerk
lines.text: Four of them signed for a counterparty rather than for a company. A counterparty is what you sign for when the thing you are representing is neither a person nor a firm — it is the category you use when there is no category.

lines.speaker: night_clerk
lines.text: That is the name, yes. And the register entry cites an enabling act from 2031 as its authority, and in nine years I have never once been able to find a debate for it. No division, no committee stage, nothing.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: There wasn't much of one. Forty members, eleven minutes, carried on the nod. I was standing in the gallery.
